author: MiaAI-Lab (engine: TensorFold by ashhart)
install_template:
(
set -euo pipefail
D={src_dir}/GLM-5.3-Flash-EXL3-2x-DGX-Sparks-TensorFold
REV=549fdc562c477d477244d2df0590d6c14bda4889
mkdir -p "$D" && cd "$D"
[ -d .git ] || git init -q
git remote get-url origin >/dev/null 2>&1 || git remote add origin https://github.com/MiaAI-Lab/GLM-5.3-Flash-EXL3-2x-DGX-Sparks-TensorFold
git fetch -q --depth 1 origin "$REV"
git checkout -q --detach "$REV"
echo "[mc] recipe at $REV"
source scripts/config.sh
source scripts/nodes.sh
[ "$WORKER" = "{worker_ssh}" ] || die "WORKER is '$WORKER' but MC chose '{worker_ssh}': scripts/local.sh or the environment overrides MC's .env - remove WORKER there"
[ "$TP" = 2 ] || die "TP is '$TP' but MC runs this recipe on two Sparks: scripts/local.sh or the environment sets TP - remove it there"
declare -F image_ident worker_image_ident >/dev/null || die "scripts/nodes.sh has no image_ident/worker_image_ident: upstream changed shape"
need_worker 1
REF=$(prebuilt_image)
case "$REF" in *@sha256:*) ;; *) die "no pinned image digest for these patches ($REF)" ;; esac
DIG=${REF##*@}
echo "[mc] pulling $REF on both Sparks (~37 GB each)"
docker pull -q "$REF"
worker 1 docker pull -q "$REF"
HERE=$(docker image inspect -f '{{.RepoDigests}}' "$REF")
THERE=$(worker 1 docker image inspect -f '{{.RepoDigests}}' "$REF")
case "$HERE" in *"@$DIG"*) ;; *) die "head: $REF has RepoDigests $HERE, not $DIG" ;; esac
case "$THERE" in *"@$DIG"*) ;; *) die "worker: $REF has RepoDigests $THERE, not $DIG" ;; esac
echo "[mc] same registry digest on both Sparks: $DIG"
docker tag "$REF" "$IMAGE"
worker 1 docker tag "$REF" "$IMAGE"
A=$(image_ident "$IMAGE")
B=$(worker_image_ident 1 "$IMAGE")
[ "$A" != missing ] && [ "$A" = "$B" ] || die "head and worker hold different $IMAGE content ($A vs $B)"
echo "[mc] same image content on both Sparks"
mc_hf_owner() {
  local hub=$1 img=$2 uid me n id p
  shift 2
  local deep=() top=()
  uid=$(id -u); me="$uid:$(id -g)"
  for id in "$@"; do
    for p in "$hub/.locks/models--${id//\//--}" "$hub/models--${id//\//--}"; do
      [ -e "$p" ] && deep+=("$p")
    done
  done
  for p in "$hub" "$hub/.locks"; do
    [ -d "$p" ] && [ -n "$(find "$p" -maxdepth 0 ! -user "$uid")" ] && top+=("$p")
  done
  mc_hf_foreign() {
    local c=${#top[@]}
    [ ${#deep[@]} -eq 0 ] || c=$((c + $( { find "${deep[@]}" ! -user "$uid" 2>/dev/null || true; } | wc -l)))
    echo "$c"
  }
  n=$(mc_hf_foreign)
  [ "$n" -eq 0 ] && return 0
  echo "[mc] $n file(s) of this recipe in $hub belong to another user (root: an earlier download ran in a container as root); a download as $(id -un) stops on them with PermissionError"
  if [ ${#deep[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
    { find "${deep[@]}" -name '*.lock' ! -user "$uid" -exec rm -f {} + 2>/dev/null || true; }
  fi
  [ "$(mc_hf_foreign)" -lt "$n" ] && echo "[mc] removed stale lock files (no download is running)"
  if [ "$(mc_hf_foreign)" -gt 0 ]; then
    echo "[mc] handing them back to $me with a one-off root container (no sudo needed)"
    [ ${#top[@]} -eq 0 ] || docker run --rm --network none --user 0:0 --entrypoint chown -v "$hub:$hub" "$img" "$me" "${top[@]}" || true
    [ ${#deep[@]} -eq 0 ] || docker run --rm --network none --user 0:0 --entrypoint chown -v "$hub:$hub" "$img" -R "$me" "${deep[@]}" || true
    uid=$(id -u); top=()
    for p in "$hub" "$hub/.locks"; do
      [ -d "$p" ] && [ -n "$(find "$p" -maxdepth 0 ! -user "$uid")" ] && top+=("$p")
    done
  fi
  n=$(mc_hf_foreign)
  if [ "$n" -gt 0 ]; then
    echo "[mc] still $n file(s) in $hub not owned by $me; fix it on this box by hand: sudo chown -R $me ${deep[*]} ${top[*]}"
    return 1
  fi
  echo "[mc] Hugging Face cache in $hub belongs to $me again"
}
mkdir -p "$STATE_DIR"
if command -v flock >/dev/null; then
  flock -n "$STATE_DIR/prepare.lock" true || die "a prepare.sh is still running on this box (it holds the download locks): wait for it to finish or stop it, then install again"
fi
mc_hf_owner "$HF_CACHE/hub" "$IMAGE" "$MODEL_ID" "$DFLASH2_ID" || die "head: files in the Hugging Face cache stay foreign (see above)"
WHF=$(worker_hf_cache 1)
worker 1 "$(declare -f mc_hf_owner); mc_hf_owner '$WHF/hub' '$IMAGE' '$MODEL_ID' '$DFLASH2_ID'" || die "worker: files in its Hugging Face cache stay foreign (see above)"
./scripts/prepare.sh
)
notes: LICENCE - NON-COMMERCIAL USE ONLY (CC BY-NC-ND drafter): the default drafter incoai/GLM-5.3-Flash-DFlash2 is licensed CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, so this recipe as shipped may only be used non-commercially. Licence-free alternative: DRAFTER=mtp uses the checkpoint's own MTP head instead - no extra licence, ~5-10% slower decode and only ONE request at a time. The drafter is the recipe's DRAFTER line in env_map (one-line change); after changing it, run the install again (it downloads only what is missing) and restart. Two DGX Sparks serve GLM-5.3 Flash (EXL3 4 bpw routed experts) with TensorFold tensor parallelism over the Sparks' RoCE link: 1,048,576-token window per request, up to 4 requests at once, served name GLM-5.3-Flash-EXL3 (the same name as the vLLM recipe, so agents keep working). MC talks to the head only; start.sh starts rank 1 on the worker itself over SSH (container glm53-flash-tf on both boxes) and stop.sh removes both. PREREQUISITES: 2x GB10 with 128 GB; the two Sparks cabled over QSFP with RoCE v2 and addresses on one subnet (set the worker's fabric address on its box in MC, else its SSH address is used); key-based SSH login from the head to the worker (the user MC knows for the worker box); Docker with the NVIDIA runtime, your user in the docker group, and rsync on both; ~205 GB free on each box. INSTALL (hours, once): MC writes WORKER/FABRIC_PEER/PORT/PREPARE/DRAFTER into the recipe's .env on the head, checks out the pinned commit, pulls the published image by digest on both boxes and compares the registry digest (RepoDigests) and then the image content (upstream's image_ident - not the local image ID, which differs between containerd and classic image stores), then runs the recipe's prepare.sh: checkpoint Mia-AiLab/GLM-5.3-Flash-EXL3-4bpw-TensorFold (~176 GB, pinned revision) and drafter download on the head, rsync to the worker. START: ./start.sh with PREPARE=0 (the install prepares, a start only starts); first start compiles kernels (~5 min), later starts take 2-6 min; ready when GET /v1/models answers on port 8000. Needs ~110 GiB MemAvailable on each box at start: MC stops other exclusive models on BOTH boxes first. MC drops the page cache on the head before every start (drop_page_cache=true): right after the install's download the cache holds so much that start.sh found too little MemAvailable and sized the window at ~224k instead of 1M tokens - seen twice on 2026-10-18, only a cache drop fixed it. The install also takes back files of this recipe that root left in the Hugging Face cache on either box (stale download locks are removed, the rest is handed back to your user by a one-off container - no sudo), so a later download as your user does not stop with PermissionError. Validated on 2x GB10 by MC on 2026-10-18 (gb10_validated=true): installed from zero and started from the UI, decode 58 / 45 tok/s, HumanEval 100/100, GSM8K 97.5 %, tool calls ok. Pinned to upstream v1.10 (commit 549fdc562c47). Also answers Anthropic's /v1/messages on the same port.

description: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (EXL3 2.9 bpw) with TensorFold across two DGX Sparks (tensor parallel over RoCE): 1M-token window, 4 requests at once, tools, image input and thinking, OpenAI /v1 API on port 8000. Installs itself on both boxes; the head must export its Hugging Face cache over NFS to the worker once (root). Permissive licences (Apache-2.0 recipe and engine, MIT weights). Optional ABLIT=1: abliterated overlay from a gated Hugging Face repo (needs your HF token and access).

Once, by hand: the head exports its Hugging Face cache over NFS to the worker (root). Abliterated weights are an option (ABLIT=1, gated: needs your HF token and access).

author: MiaAI-Lab (engine: TensorFold by ashhart, dsv41 family by BertholomusAI)
install_template:
(
set -euo pipefail
D={src_dir}/DeepSeek-v4.1-Flash-1017-2x-DGX-Sparks
REV=e65785cd3cde8e23c38d60a732a014abb6ccb533
mkdir -p "$D" && cd "$D"
[ -d .git ] || git init -q
git remote get-url origin >/dev/null 2>&1 || git remote add origin https://github.com/MiaAI-Lab/DeepSeek-v4.1-Flash-1017-2x-DGX-Sparks
git fetch -q --depth 1 origin "$REV"
git checkout -q --detach "$REV"
echo "[mc] recipe at $REV"
source scripts/config.sh
source scripts/nodes.sh
[ "$WORKER" = "{worker_ssh}" ] || die "WORKER is '$WORKER' but MC chose '{worker_ssh}': scripts/local.sh or the environment overrides MC's .env - remove WORKER there"
[ "$TP" = 2 ] || die "TP is '$TP' but MC runs this recipe on two Sparks"
declare -F image_ident worker_image_ident prebuilt_image prepared_state >/dev/null || die "scripts/config.sh or scripts/nodes.sh has no image_ident/worker_image_ident/prebuilt_image/prepared_state: upstream changed shape"
need_worker 1
if [ -z "$NFS_SERVER" ] && command -v ss >/dev/null; then
  LISTEN=$(ss -ltn 2>/dev/null || true)
  grep -Eq '[:.]2049[[:space:]]' <<<"$LISTEN" || die "this Spark serves no NFS (nothing listens on port 2049), but the worker reads its Hugging Face cache over NFS. Once, as root on this Spark: apt install nfs-kernel-server; add the line '$NFS_PATH <worker link address>(ro,no_subtree_check)' to /etc/exports; exportfs -ra (upstream README, NFS). Then install again"

REF=$(prebuilt_image)
case "$REF" in

  *) PULL=0; echo "[mc] no pinned image digest for this commit ($REF is only a tag): prepare.sh builds it locally from the pinned sources (~6 min) and copies it to the worker" ;;
esac
mc_hf_owner() {
  local hub=$1 img=$2 uid me n id p
  shift 2
  local deep=() top=()
  uid=$(id -u); me="$uid:$(id -g)"
  for id in "$@"; do
    for p in "$hub/.locks/models--${id//\//--}" "$hub/models--${id//\//--}"; do
      [ -e "$p" ] && deep+=("$p")
    done
  done
  for p in "$hub" "$hub/.locks"; do
    [ -d "$p" ] && [ -n "$(find "$p" -maxdepth 0 ! -user "$uid")" ] && top+=("$p")
  done
  mc_hf_foreign() {
    local c=${#top[@]}
    [ ${#deep[@]} -eq 0 ] || c=$((c + $( { find "${deep[@]}" ! -user "$uid" 2>/dev/null || true; } | wc -l)))
    echo "$c"
  }
  n=$(mc_hf_foreign)
  [ "$n" -eq 0 ] && return 0
  echo "[mc] $n file(s) of this recipe in $hub belong to another user (root: an earlier download ran in a container as root); a download as $(id -un) stops on them with PermissionError"
  if [ ${#deep[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
    { find "${deep[@]}" -name '*.lock' ! -user "$uid" -exec rm -f {} + 2>/dev/null || true; }
  fi
  [ "$(mc_hf_foreign)" -lt "$n" ] && echo "[mc] removed stale lock files (no download is running)"
  if [ "$(mc_hf_foreign)" -gt 0 ]; then
    echo "[mc] handing them back to $me with a one-off root container (no sudo needed)"
    [ ${#top[@]} -eq 0 ] || docker run --rm --network none --user 0:0 --entrypoint chown -v "$hub:$hub" "$img" "$me" "${top[@]}" || true
    [ ${#deep[@]} -eq 0 ] || docker run --rm --network none --user 0:0 --entrypoint chown -v "$hub:$hub" "$img" -R "$me" "${deep[@]}" || true
    uid=$(id -u); top=()
    for p in "$hub" "$hub/.locks"; do
      [ -d "$p" ] && [ -n "$(find "$p" -maxdepth 0 ! -user "$uid")" ] && top+=("$p")
    done
  fi
  n=$(mc_hf_foreign)
  if [ "$n" -gt 0 ]; then
    echo "[mc] still $n file(s) in $hub not owned by $me; fix it on this box by hand: sudo chown -R $me ${deep[*]} ${top[*]}"
    return 1
  fi
  echo "[mc] Hugging Face cache in $hub belongs to $me again"
}
mkdir -p "$STATE_DIR"
if command -v flock >/dev/null; then
  flock -n "$STATE_DIR/prepare.lock" true || die "a prepare.sh is still running on this box (it holds the download locks): wait for it to finish or stop it, then install again"
fi
CHOWN_IMG=$IMAGE
docker image inspect "$IMAGE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || CHOWN_IMG=$BASE_IMAGE
IDS=("$MODEL_ID" "$ENGRAM_ID")
[ "$ABLIT" != 1 ] || IDS+=("$ABLIT_ID")
mc_hf_owner "$HF_CACHE/hub" "$CHOWN_IMG" "${IDS[@]}" || die "head: files in the Hugging Face cache stay foreign (see above)"
PULL=$PULL ./scripts/prepare.sh
A=$(image_ident "$IMAGE")
B=$(worker_image_ident 1 "$IMAGE")
[ "$A" != missing ] && [ "$A" = "$B" ] || die "head and worker hold different $IMAGE content ($A vs $B)"
echo "[mc] same image content on both Sparks"
[ "$(prepared_state)" = "$(cat "$PREPARED_MARKER" 2>/dev/null)" ] || die "prepare.sh finished but its marker $PREPARED_MARKER does not match this setup: run the install again"
echo "[mc] prepare.sh left both Sparks ready (ABLIT=$ABLIT)"
)
notes: LICENCE - permissive, commercial use allowed: the recipe's own scripts are Apache-2.0 (its LICENSE and NOTICE); the engine is TensorFold (Apache-2.0) in BertholomusAI's dsv41 fork and kernel kit (Apache-2.0; the kit carries Triton MIT, PyTorch/CUTLASS BSD-3-Clause and the ExLlamaV3 EXL3 format MIT); the base model deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is MIT (Copyright (c) 2023 DeepSeek) - its own DSpark draft blocks do the speculative decoding, so there is no separately licensed drafter; the quantization Mia-AiLab/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-EXL3-EAQ-v1-2.9-bpw is MIT; the optional abliteration overlay drowzeys/keys-DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-Abliterated is MIT; the image is built on NVIDIA's PyTorch container (nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:26.07-py3, NVIDIA's container licence). The weights are downloaded from Hugging Face, not shipped by the recipe. ABLIT OPTION (off by default): ABLIT=0 serves the stock weights. ABLIT=1 applies the abliteration overlay (refusal directions removed in 104 attention tensors of layers 10-35) from the gated (access-controlled) Hugging Face repo drowzeys/keys-DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-Abliterated (pinned at 0bdc2036). It needs BOTH a Hugging Face read token on the head (HF_TOKEN in the recipe's .env, or hf auth login) AND access granted on that repo's page for the token's account; without them prepare.sh stops before any download. It writes a separate checkpoint and a separate ~106 GB weight file per Spark (extra disk up to another checkpoint's size). To switch: set ABLIT=1 in this recipe's env_map (one-line change, MC writes it into the .env), run the install again, then restart; ABLIT=0 switches back. Upstream does not validate the abliterated mode's quality. WHAT IT IS: two DGX Sparks serve DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (EXL3 EAQ v1, 2.9 bits a weight, ~196 GiB checkpoint with the vision tower and the DSpark draft blocks) with TensorFold's native Zig engine, tensor parallel over the Sparks' RoCE link: OpenAI /v1 API on port 8000, served name DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, 1,048,576-token window, 4 requests at once (they share the window's pool), thinking on unless a request turns it off, tool calls, image input (always on). Engram's two n-gram tables come unquantized from deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (shards 47 and 48, ~203 GB, pinned revision). MC talks to the head only; start.sh starts rank 1 on the worker itself over SSH (container dsv41-1017-exl3-tf on both boxes) and stop.sh removes both. PREREQUISITES: 2x GB10 with 128 GB; the two Sparks cabled over QSFP with RoCE v2 and addresses on one subnet (set the worker's fabric address on its box in MC, else its SSH address is used); key-based SSH login from the head to the worker; Docker with the NVIDIA runtime and your user in the docker group on both; git, python3 and the hf CLI on the head; disk ~505 GB on the head (checkpoint, Engram tables, rank 0's ~106 GB weight file) plus ~25 GB for the image, ~310 GB on the worker. NFS (once, by hand, needs root - MC cannot do it): the worker reads the head's Hugging Face cache read-only over NFS, so on the head install nfs-kernel-server, export the Hugging Face cache read-only to the worker's link address in /etc/exports (ro,no_subtree_check) and run exportfs -ra (upstream README, NFS). prepare.sh then creates the read-only docker NFS volume on the worker itself (no sudo there) and checks that the worker sees every file. MC leaves NFS_SERVER unset, so the worker mounts from the head's address on the link that nodes.sh finds; set NFS_SERVER/NFS_PATH in the recipe's .env only for another server or an NFSv4 fsid=0 export. The install stops early with these steps when nothing listens on port 2049 on the head. INSTALL (hours, once): MC writes WORKER/FABRIC_PEER/PORT/PREPARE/ABLIT into the recipe's .env on the head, checks out the pinned commit, takes back root-owned files of this recipe in the head's Hugging Face cache (stale locks removed, the rest handed back by a one-off container, no sudo), and runs the recipe's prepare.sh. No published image exists for this commit (scripts/config.sh sets no IMAGE_DIGEST), so prepare.sh builds the image on the head from the pinned sources (PULL=0: never a tag pull; ~6 min) and copies it to the worker with docker save | docker load, then downloads the checkpoint and Engram's tables on the head, writes rank 0's weight file on the head and rank 1's on the worker's own disk (~106 GB each), and copies Engram's tables to the worker. Afterwards MC checks itself that both Sparks hold the same image content (upstream's image_ident) and that prepare.sh's ready marker matches. START: ./start.sh with PREPARE=0 (the install prepares, a start only starts); ready when GET /v1/models answers on port 8000, then start.sh runs a smoke test. MEMORY: ~105 GiB per Spark while serving; start.sh refuses to start unless 112 GiB are available on EACH Spark (MIN_AVAIL_GIB), and its memory guard kills a rank's container below 2.5 GiB available (MEMGUARD_GIB) because a rank that takes all memory freezes a Spark. MC stops other exclusive models on BOTH boxes first and drops the page cache on the head before every start (drop_page_cache=true). CONTEXT, PARALLEL, MIN_AVAIL_GIB and MEMGUARD_GIB keep upstream's defaults; change them in the recipe's .env only if you know why. STATUS: run by hand on 2x GB10 on 2026-10-19; gb10_validated stays false until the one-click install through MC has run end to end from zero, every member shows the model loaded and the spark-bench-standard run is done, and speed and quality are not yet measured by MC (upstream's README has its own numbers). Pinned to upstream commit e65785cd3cde.
